newsitem.title: UK: Palm oil steady on range bound Euro veg oil market.
newsitem.headline: Palm oil steady on range bound Euro veg oil market.

text.p: Palm oil prices were steady on a range bound market in Europe on Thursday morning.
Traders expected little activity ahead of the Easter Break.
"I think all we will see is some book squaring ahead of the holiday," said one.
Crude palm oil cif Europe opened $5 up to unchanged after May/Jul traded at $545 a tonne.
March traded at $552.50 in a switch with Oct/Dec at $555.
Coconut oil was not quoted at the opening but palmkernel oil started the session $2.50 down.
Dutch soy oil sellers were 0.50 to 1.50 guilders up while rape oil was one to 1.25 guilders higher.
